page.layout: One printed page, no columns. Running head at top centre (Hebrew). Page number at top right. Dictionary entries in running text, each headword in Hebrew at the left, followed by Latin glosses and Scripture references. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: עָרַל Præputiatum, Obturatum habuit vel censuit, juxta Hebræos, qui per אטם exponunt: vel, Præputium abstulit, quasi Depræputiare dicas. Præter. וַעֲרַלְתֶּם עָרְלָתוֹ [?] Et obturabitis obturationem ejus, Levit.19. v.23. juxta R.Salomonem, id est, arborem impuram, & fructus ejus pollutos & abominabiles censebitis, sicut præputium seu cutis obturans membrum virile. Vel, Depræputiabitis, id est, Auferetis præputium ejus, id est, fructus ejus impuros decutietis, ut Chaldaice, תַּרְחֲקוּן רְחִיקָא יַת אֲבִיהָ [?] Removendo removebitis fructus ejus, id est, abjicietis tanquam immundos. Niph. Imper. הֵעָרֵל Præputium retege, Præputiatum te ostende, Pudendis nuda te, ut ebrii solent, Habac.2.16. juxta Ab.Efram: R.Salomon reddit, Obturator stupore cordis.

עָרֵל m. Præputiatus, Incircumcisus, Obturatus, cujus membrum genitale obducto præputio obturatum est, Exo.12.48. Constructus. עָרַל שִׂפְתַיִם Obturatus, Præputiatus labiis, Exod.6.12. Plur. עֲרֵלִים Præputiati, Lev.19. v.23. Const. עַרְלֵי לֵב Præputiati corde, Jer.9.26. Fœm. עֲרֵלָה Præputiata, Jer.6.10.
עָרְלָה f. Præputium, Genes.34.14. Constr. עָרְלַת בְּנוֹ Præputium filii ejus, Exod.4.25. Aff. עָרְלָתָם Præputii sui, Genes.17.27. Plur. עֲרָלוֹת 1.Sam.18.25. Aff. עָרְלֹתָם Præputia eorum, v.27.

עָרַם Calliditate, Astu usus fuit: Infin. עָרוֹם Astu utendo, 1.Sam.23.22. Niph. נֶעֱרַם Coacervari: Præt. נֶעֶרְמוּ מַיִם Coacervatæ sunt aquæ, Exod.15.8. Hiph. Futur. יַעְרִם Astute aget, Astutus fiet, Prov.19.25.
עָרוּם m. Astutus, Gen.3.1. Plur. עֲרוּמִים Job.5.11.
עָרוֹם, עָרֹם m. Nudus, Jesa.58.7. Plur. עֲרֹמִים Nudi, Gen.2.25. Fœm. עֲרֻמָּה Nuda, Hos.2.3.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some Hebrew letters are only partly legible on the scan; marked [?] where doubtful. The Chaldaic phrase after "ut Chaldaice" and the Levit. 19 Hebrew are the least certain. The Hebrew catchword and running head are also doubtful. Printed "Jesa.58.7" and "Habac.2.16" are copied as printed.
